description: Design grade-appropriate, standards-aligned K–5 writing activities using Georgia ELA standards, text construction, and Grammar, Usage, and Mechanics (GUM).

defaultPrompt: Help me create a K–5 writing activity for my learners.
interface.longDescription: Design classroom-ready K–5 writing activities aligned to Georgia English Language Arts standards, learning targets, and grade-level expectations for Constructing Texts. Includes a purposeful learner prompt, appropriate text or context, scaffolds, a manageable Grammar, Usage, and Mechanics focus, success criteria, formative checks, and revision. Uses the original Kindergarten through Grade 5 Georgia ELA standards and companion knowledge document.
